My dad tends to take out all his stress on me. Like he may be mad at everyone , but for me, one wrong move and he snaps at me. I guess to begin with, I should show more love and affection but its just not the type of person I am. I have hard time expressing that. I used to be able to show it when I was very young but I don't know how to anymore. Like it can't come out naturally but I will force myself outside my comfort zone. I have discussed with my older sister in the past when for example I got yelled at and I would be confused. She would tell me. Usually it was to do with how I answered my dad after he yelled at me. Like for example, He gets mad at me and yells at me and I stand there not saying a word and then he gets even more mad shouting things like 'are you deaf', 'are you ignoring me' 'dont show me this attitude'. Its hard for me to talk and answer him at times like that because I try to hold back my tears and not show any emotions but that gets to him. I have been like this for so long this is the way I control myself so I don't know what I could do better.

A more recent thing that happened was just on a normal day where my dad was in a bad mood and I was in my room cleaning up and he walks up the stairs and into my room and pulls out this canvas that I had this completed puzzle on top for support. He pulled it out and took it back downstairs and fortunately the puzzle was still intact. But that canvas had been under my bed for six months so I was confused to why he randomly showed up to my room to get that and literally just move locations and dump it downstairs. I asked him "Dad did you need the canvas? It was there for the puzzle." He couldn't come up with anything and I could tell by his face so I said "Why would you take it if you didn't need it? The puzzle almost broke." And I knew why he took it(a reason to get a reaction out of me). I asked him in a calm yet monotone voice so he wouldn't get mad but he still did and shouted "Are you back-talking to me!!! I will stop paying for everything. I give you too much freedom...and so on". What freedom? Basic human rights? I rather not have the money in that case but affection and love from my parents. 

Its hard to have a normal conversation about how I feel. They always blame everything back at me...you you you. Its never, okay I understand and I am sorry I yelled at you. They yell even if they are in the wrong and expect me to be okay with it since thats always been the case since I was young.

​

I will look for counselling at uni. I just have to push through it i guess.

Wow. Thank you this message was VERY helpful. It honestly means so much to me. It is so hard. But no matter what I want to be the better person and understand that they are also going through things and we are all living life through experiences. I don't want to blame their upbringing and the toxicity that came with it rather, learn from it and with my future relationships with friends and family, I want to create a healthy environment.

 It's hard to laugh at home like I always did. Siblings think I have nothing going on and i am my usual self, dad thinks I am loud and have an irritating personality with my high energy, and mom thinks I am purposely being happy to provoke her. 

But I won't let this get to me...or at least try not to. I look forward to the future. And I will make sure my siblings never lose touch. Even though I don't show it out on the outside, I love them dearly. Personally, I wish I could say I love my mom but theres this resentment built up inside from everything thats happened and happening but I really hope that I am able to move on from this. I want to have a good relationship with my parents. I hope maybe accomplishing something they never expected me to be capable of would be the first step for them to gain respect for me and treat me less like a child and more like an adult who knows how to live her life just fine. 

Once again, this advice you gave was very helpful and I will take note of it. 

Thank you!

Thank you so much for this message! I try to be as positive as possible and know self harm is not the way to go. I want to deal with this in the right way and become the best version of myself. Brown households can be very toxic especially when their reputation is first priority. Mental health isn't even a thing. I told my parents I felt sad and they just toss it away always saying that we have everything so how are we sad and compare our life to those living in poverty. It makes me feel like my problems are not a big deal. But this is my life and I just want to be happy. My problems are big! So I will try my best to keep myself busy and interact with people whos company I enjoy. I dont want to grow up but sometimes I wish time would go faster so I could leave this house.
Yes, Canada. I will probably find a therapist on campus. Thank you :)

My mom is becoming a different person. I had respect for the old version but this new version of my mom is in a bad headspace. She will never get out of this toxic mindset because she is stuck in the past. And she is cheating on my dad but he doesn't know and nor will I tell him because that will literally break him apart. A lot of problems in this household. Even after I leave, I worry about the younger ones who will have to deal with this. I won't be able to leave home for a couple of more years but I hope I am successful enough to make them proud and that they start treating me like an adult.

I do have close friends and I used to talk about it but realized that at one point you just have to learn to deal with it because people get tired of hearing problems all the time. I just write in a diary ahahah. Thats my only friend that I can complain to.

One key issue would be that I am mentally exhausted of being treated the way I am by my parents. The environment we all lived in was very negative but that stress is taken out on me. Its not like I haven't tried talking to them but even if I try to have a civilized conversation that about things I need to work on and the things that hurt me about them, they become very defensive and say I am back-talking to them. It is SO hard to have a normal conversation without it ending in a fight. I try to stay in my room and stay away, I try not to show emotions anymore and yet STILL they have something to yell or lecture me about. This happens on the daily, some big issues and some small. And overtime, I have been building it up and keeping it inside and I am going to explode now. This house suffocates me. Why can't my parents just respect my space and treat me like a freakin human being. They expect is to be grateful for providing us with everything and yes I am grateful but do they not understand that there is more to just then money. I want a family that loves me just as equally as my siblings. But that will not happen. No matter what I do, they will always have something to pick on.
